get.description: Gets all Groups in a given Company

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description:
Unique identifier for the company. This parameter accepts both formats:
- **Recommended**: Procore company ID (integer) - Use this for new integrations
- Legacy: LaborChart UUID format (uuid string) - Supported for backward compatibility

A proxy layer automatically handles both formats, but using the Procore company ID is preferred for consistency with other Procore APIs.

items.description: Response schema for a single Group.

timezone.description: The timezone associated with the Group.

color.description: Hexadecimal color code for the Group.

address_1.description: The first part of the Group's address.

address_2.description: The second part of the Group's address (e.g., Building, Suite, Unit).

city_town.description: The city or town where the Group is located.

state_province.description: The state or province where the Group is located.

zipcode.description: The postal/zip code for the Group.

country.description: The country where the Group is located.

contact_name.description: The primary Point of Contact (P.O.C.) for the Group.

contact_number.description: Phone number for the Group’s Point of Contact.

contact_email.description: Email address for the Group’s Point of Contact.

error.description: If you receive a 401 error, please ensure you are following the OAuth 2.0 guidelines outlined at https://developers.procore.com/documentation/introduction and verify you can successfully call the /me endpoint using your access token. Additionally, the user associated with that token must be added as a user in the Workforce Planning People List for the corresponding company.

schema.description: Request body schema for creating a new Group.

city_town.description: The City or Town for the Group.

state_province.description: The State or Province for the Group.

zipcode.description: Zip or Postal Code for the Group.

contact_name.description: The Point of Contact (P.O.C.) name for the Group.

contact_phone.description: Phone number for the Group's Point of Contact. Must include country and area code.

contact_email.description: Email address for the Group's Point of Contact.

schema.description: Response schema for successfully creating a Group.

id.description: Unique identifier for the newly created Group.

Additionally, the user associated with that token must be added as a user in the Workforce Planning People List for the corresponding company.

delete.description: Delete a single Group in a given ID. It should be noted that you can not delete a Group that has active Projects or People belonging to it. This is to prevent those entities from being "stranded" in the system if the group you are trying to delete is the single group they belong to. When you try to delete a Group that can not be deleted for this reason, you will be provided with a list of Project and People IDs that belong to this group so you can remove this group ID from those entities if you choose.
